evacuation.trigger_text: Evacuate when the county emergency manager declares a mandatory evacuation for this zone, or when river stage is forecast to exceed the levee crest within 24 hours.

slug.text: Identifier this planning record uses for the facility. Not a name, not a place: the blinded rendering replaces it with FACILITY-<hash>.
slug.source_doc: This planning record (fictional, for documentation only)

occupancy_type.text: Critical access hospital, twenty-five licensed beds.

county_fips.text: County FIPS 99001, a county that does not exist, in the fixture state the test suite uses.

census.text: Average midnight census over the last twelve months, twenty-four occupants.

staff_on_shift.text: Eleven staff on the overnight shift, the smallest staffing the roster runs.

power.generator.text: One 400 kW diesel generator serving the essential electrical system.

power.fuel_hours.text: Day tank and bulk tank together hold seventy-two hours at full essential load.

power.switchgear_elevation_ft.text: Essential switchgear on the ground floor at six and a half feet above datum.

power.transfer_switch_elevation_ft.text: Automatic transfer switch in the same ground-floor room as the switchgear.

power.load_test_interval_days.text: Monthly load test recorded in the generator log.

water.on_site_storage_hours.text: Potable storage covers eighteen hours at the plan's reduced consumption rate.

design_intensity.flood_elevation_ft.text: Base flood elevation for this building, nine and a half feet above datum.

design_intensity.flood_elevation_source.text: The certificate the elevation was read from, held by the planner.

design_intensity.design_wind_mph.text: Design wind speed from the structural drawings.

evacuation.trigger_written.text: The evacuation trigger is written into the plan rather than left to judgement.

evacuation.trigger_text.text: The trigger as the annex words it.

evacuation.authority.text: The administrator on call holds the authority to order an evacuation.

evacuation.transport_lead_hours.text: The regional transport contract asks for eighteen hours of notice.

evacuation.priority_order_written.text: The annex names no occupant priority order; the gap report says so.

transfer_agreements.text: Two receiving facilities, one signed and one still in draft, with the county, floodplain and grid feeder recorded for each.

co_located_operators.text: An independent dialysis operator leases part of the ground floor.
